decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on the 20th April 2004, the matter described above is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The proposed extension to the dwellinghouse of a partial gable end extending 3.9m from the existing hipped ridgeline, being 2.7m high and having a base width of 4.9m, with a volume of 11.78m3, as well as a rear dormer with dimensions of 3.5m deep, 2.7m high with a width of 5.8m, having a volume of 27.41m3 together with the existing outbuilding, which has a volume of 15.4m3, providing a total extension volume of 54.59m3 to the original dwellinghouse, qualifies as Class B and C permitted development within Part 1 of Schedule 2 of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.

The proposed roof extension does not therefore require planning permission.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the proposed erection of a hip to gable end and rear roof extension to existing dwellinghouse.
